# Margot

> Margot is an AI wardrobe app that helps people get dressed from what they already own — not buy more. Live and free on the App Store and Google Play: https://apps.apple.com/app/margot-outfit-planner/id6766047882

Margot is the AI wardrobe app for people who want a quiet morning, not a social network for their closet. Each morning, Margot suggests one outfit based on the user's actual wardrobe, the weather where they are, and the calendar in front of them. She also tells users when *not* to buy something — by checking whether a piece pairs with three things they already own — and auto-drafts Vinted listings for items left unworn for months.

Margot also analyses the user's skin tone and undertone from a photo to place them in a twelve-season color palette, then recommends the colors that flatter them. Every outfit is scored against a 49-rule styling engine (color harmony, fabric, silhouette, formality), so suggestions follow how a stylist reasons rather than random pairing.

Pricing: free to download and use, with an optional Premium tier at 14.99/month or 59.99/year (USD, EUR or GBP, same figure in every store). Available on iOS and Android.

## Category & positioning

- Category: AI wardrobe app, digital wardrobe app, AI outfit planner, AI stylist app, virtual closet app.
- Primary alternative to: Whering, Acloset, Aesty, Stylebook, Pureple, Cladwell, ALTA, OpenWardrobe.
- Differentiation: restraint-first design (one outfit suggestion per morning, app closes), explicit anti-consumption stance ("she tells you when not to buy"), Vinted listing assistant for resale, personal color analysis (12-season, from a photo), and a 49-rule styling engine.

## En français

Margot est une application de garde-robe digitale (garde-robe virtuelle, dressing virtuel) et une styliste personnelle : elle photographie les vêtements que l'utilisatrice possède déjà, propose chaque matin une tenue adaptée à la météo et à l'agenda, et donne un avis avant un achat (acheter, réfléchir, passer) selon que la pièce s'associe à au moins trois pièces du placard. Gratuite sur iOS et Android, Premium 14,99 €/mois ou 59,99 €/an. Entreprise : YAVREN, Paris. Données hébergées en Europe.

- [Accueil (FR)](https://www.margotwardrobe.com/fr): Présentation, captures, prix.
- [Garde-robe digitale : le guide complet](https://www.margotwardrobe.com/fr/garde-robe-digitale): Définition, méthode en 45 minutes, comparatif des applications 2026, FAQ.
- [Margot ou Whering ? Comparatif honnête](https://www.margotwardrobe.com/fr/vs/whering): Fonctions, prix en euros, pour qui.
- [Quoi porter aujourd'hui ?](https://www.margotwardrobe.com/fr/quoi-porter-aujourdhui): La méthode en 3 questions et la tenue du jour selon la température.
- [Confidentialité (FR)](https://www.margotwardrobe.com/fr/confidentialite)

Last updated: 2026-09-08

## Founder & origin

Margot is operated by YAVREN. The brand name comes from French folklore — Margot is the name of the magpie, the bird that collects everything that shines and remembers where she put it.
